bug_info.bug_desc: Startup two-pass completion and continuous completion/disable transition directly to Sha3Prep, asserting the halt request in the immediately following cycle. They omit the required intervening message-complete cycle with halt request low, so the last message has no specified settling/acceptance interval before preparation.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add a Sha3MsgDone state to the FSM enum and re-encode the state vector to make room for it. Change the StartupPass1 two-pass-success path and the ContHTRunning completion/disable path to go to Sha3MsgDone first, and add a Sha3MsgDone case that advances to Sha3Prep on the next cycle. This gives SHA-3 one cycle to absorb the final message before the halt request is asserted.
